provenance.transcription: 503 OLE equations decoded and matched against 503 WMF previews; source numbering normalized to worked examples 1–12 and practice 1–24.
provenance.figures: 21 editable SVG illustrations generated by figures/generate.py and compared individually with the archived source illustrations. Revisions restore source projection and visibility for the square-section vessel and pyramid, plane sections, cap equator and ellipse halves, revolution direction, reflected boundaries, and the hollow toy rim/axis. Function curves and circular angles are computed from the stated equations. Original source images remain archived in the DOCX only.
source_corrections: Worked example 2 solution: correct upper integration bound from 2 to 1.
Practice 9 solution: correct the antiderivative of x+2 to x²/2+2x.
Practice 12 solution: on [0,1] the two curves lie on the same side of the x-axis, not opposite sides.
Practice 15 solution: add the missing square to the integrand for the volume of revolution.
Practice 23(c) solution: the absolute-value integral is 1, not 1/12; the source false verdict is unchanged.
Evaluation bars and differentials normalized to native Typst notation; intentionally false statements remain unchanged.
source_discrepancies_preserved: Worked example 11: the source gives a,b as positive integers but does not require a/b to be in lowest terms. The question is preserved; the solution explains why P is not unique without that condition and identifies the interpretation behind source answer 73.

qa.content_review: 36 exercises (12 worked and 24 practice), all 503 MathType OLE equations decoded and matched to their WMF previews; corrections and unresolved source ambiguity recorded separately. Complete page-by-page source proofing remains pending.
qa.figure_review: Square-section model: right-angle marker endpoints recalculated from the projected x/depth rays at their vertices; dimension leader now points to the vertical side of the square section rather than its base edge. Render inspected individually. Other earlier figure checks retained; full-page visual review pending.
qa.figures: Vector figure geometry retained except the corrected square-section markers/leader. Layout overrides: question-only toy 72 mm and pyramid 90 mm, solution graph of worked example 10 68 mm. Earlier variant-specific compact cap and sphere pair retained. Answer-only practice 13 illustration is now 64 mm wide; geometry and labels unchanged. Answer-only practice 19 pair height reduced to 50 mm; other variants unchanged. Answer-only practice 22 pyramid width is 78 mm; geometry and the other variants unchanged. Final answer compaction: solution pyramid 80 mm, toy 80 mm, intersecting-spheres diagram 64 mm; vector geometry unchanged.
qa.pagination: Answer PDF now 21 pages, with complete practice 24(d), final volume calculation, verdict and HẾT on page 21. It retains 36 questions and 36 solution headings. Question-only and writing PDFs remain unchanged at 11 and 20 pages. Compaction is local to the final exercises: smaller solution pyramid and toy illustrations, narrower final figure/text grid, and tighter paragraph/statement/title gaps; body font size and line leading unchanged.
qa.header: Shared DXT header uses the original logo and a tab gradient lightening from right to left.
qa.text_bounds: Final answer PDF bbox check finds no body words outside x=30–570 pt; 36 question labels and 36 solution headings verified. Full-page visual review remains pending.
qa.writing_balance: Equal minimum 3 lines and shared fractional remainder retained. First question now shares page 1 with theory and its complete ruled area; no writing lines from that question spill onto page 2. Overall writing variant reduced from 21 to 20 pages.
